# ARKhives 8.20.0

My Reviewers opens in Overview: a full subject preview with existing icons, matching subject colors, MCQ and flashcard slides, combined mastery, due reviews, new cards, unseen MCQs and repair counts. Select the subject header to search, filter and sort subjects. Grid remains available. Both desktop and mobile keep their own layouts and use the existing study setup and learning data.

Desktop lesson tools add a private capture tray, comparison of two captures, structured notebook templates, purposeful bookmarks, editable source-based personal practice, saved workspace arrangements, link health checks, return-to-note navigation, local timing diagnostics and session recaps. The notebook drawer groups notebook actions, editing settings and recovery tools. Source-aware AI previews identify the material supplied before insertion.

Motion respects reduced-motion settings. Study-mode slides have an explicit pause control. Private lesson material stays in the personal desktop library; personal practice does not alter published question banks or official review scheduling.
